title: Universal characterization of the second hierarchy class
statement: For every language $L$ of finite binary strings, $L\in\Pi_2^P$ if and only if there are natural numbers $C,c$ and a language $L'\in\mathsf{NP}$ such that, for every binary string $x$, membership $x\in L$ is equivalent to the condition that every binary string $u$ of length $C(|x|+1)^c$ satisfies $\langle x,u\rangle\in L'$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a language of finite binary strings
